Home/Foundations/Tokens

Tokens

Generated from code 492 semantic tokens, light + dark

The semantic layer: every token the platform defines, what it resolves to in each theme, and the utility class that applies it.

How to use a token

Each CSS variable is exposed as a utility class of the same name, minus the leading dashes. Use the class rather than a var() in an arbitrary value, so it stays greppable and dark mode follows automatically.

template
<!-- correct: greppable, follows dark mode --> <div class="surface-neutral-light border border-neutral-default text-neutral-body">…</div> <!-- wrong: not greppable, no dark-mode story --> <div class="bg-[var(--surface-neutral-light)]">…</div> <!-- wrong: raw palette, will not re-theme --> <div class="bg-cca-neutrals-50">…</div>
